2026-2645-3430-5928.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
2026-2645-3430-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

5256-6553-8207.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2577-5478-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5478-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-5478-6798-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1270-3228-5434-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

874-1170-1329-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-7297.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2557-3899-6791.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

5909-7106.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters, it triggers, causing each player to exile all but the bottom six cards of their library.
Cast Fractured Sanity by paying {U}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill the rest of their library.

250-779-1479-5226-6528.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5226-6528.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

5696-5702-7060.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
5696-5702-7060.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

1680-3767-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X creatures that share a creature type.
1680-3767-3918-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1497-4699-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

997-4871-6291.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

856-1808-4231-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {R}.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1247-5840-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-5840-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Nantuko Elder's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

372-1809-2955.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

974-4499-5470.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-4499-5470.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Ghired.
Repeat from step 3.
974-4499-5470.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and/or use Emiel the Blessed to blink any other creature(s) as desired.

5184-5636-5742-5743.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

877-2292-4254-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
877-2292-4254-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ebondeath, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

500-864-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-864-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Eternal Witness and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Eternal Witness tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1039-2301-3358.notablePrerequisites:
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
It is your upkeep step.
1039-2301-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Hell's Caretaker.
When Teardrop Kami dies, Abzan Ascendancy's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing the Spirit, returning Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

250-779-833-2546.description:
Activate Soul of Windgrace's first ability by paying {G} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Surly Badgersaur and The Gitrog Monster's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Surly Badgersaur trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gitrog Monster trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace ability, causing you to gain three life.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

215-1526-1627-1909.notablePrerequisites:
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-1627-1909.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Llanowar Elves to your hand from the battlefield, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Symbiote from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Cast Llanowar Elves by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1987-2427-2556-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.

2313-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2313-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.
